description: Μίσθωση λεωφορείων-πούλμαν is a dataset listed in data.gov.gr, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ξενοφών Σαρικάκης. Наем на до три (3) туристически автобуса/автобуси, които да се използват за транспортиране на пациенти от техните домове до заведенията за психично здраве на EKEPSYE и от тях до техните домове. Coverage: Ξενοφών Σαρικάκης. The portal shows the English title as "Noleggio di autobus e pullman" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ξενοφών Σαρικάκης. Its keywords include Από μετάπτωση, repository.data.gov.gr, Υγεία. The listing shows 2026-02-23 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-gr.
